sourceNotes.rawContent:
Romantic and refreshing — our Pink Rose & Emerald Vine Anti-Tarnish Necklace features soft blush pink oval CZ stones nestled between lush emerald green leaf accents on a gold-plated V-shaped vine design. Fresh, feminine, and full of charm — it's the kind of necklace that makes you smile every time you wear it.
- 💛 Gold-plated with anti-tarnish coating
- 🌸 Blush pink oval CZ + emerald green leaf stones
- 🌿 V-shaped vine pendant — soft and graceful
- 🔗 Delicate gold chain with secure clasp
- 🎁 Ideal for birthdays, anniversaries & festive gifting
Pairs beautifully with: Pastel pink, mint green, white, or floral ethnic and western outfits.
